title: Widen the Search Map
warm:
Widen the search map meant [player_name] refused to let Crownspire be the only name Vivienne's absence could wear. Early thirties, she/her, across-the-hall neighbor—she stood over a second address with Nolan Greer while Detective Imani Brooks's homicide interest rose without a settled body. Four fates still open: willing leave, paid vanish, dead, staging. Widening did not force any of them.

"Second address," Nolan said, mid-forties holding, brutal charm, cufflinks clicking once. "Soft alibi expands. Soft also means Pell will hate the map and Brooks will love it." Wind sheer against glass. Elevator chime. Unused perfume from the bath she should not know. Marcus Pell preferred traveling. Rhea Quinn's slate still held thinning Crownspire marks—and now a line that pointed elsewhere.

[player_name] did not invent death by widening. She did not invent willing leave. The second address only proved Vivienne's cadence might have lived in more than one building—and that method or coincidence still depended on which fear she fed. Soft meant pliable evidence with a larger geography.

Across the hall, her apartment. Black car. Wine rings. Hope and dread shared the map.

"Seal parts with Pell's quiet deal," Nolan murmured, "or mercy-rewrite what you'll swear while the map stays wide. Neither settles Vivienne. Both spend the second name."

She catalogued the widened search the way Brooks would: two addresses, no forced fate, soft still claimed. Crownspire held its hush and lost its monopoly. [player_name] felt the map watching her mouth, and understood that widening had already changed which soft she could still claim—without locking Vivienne into any single ending.

Early thirties, across-the-hall aching, mid-forties money close enough that cufflinks kissed her wrist. Vivienne's perfume as third heat. Soft alibi pulse; larger geography made it hammer between her thighs.

"Widen," he murmured. Rain-money cologne. Brooks's homicide interest without a corpse. Crime plot; sex intimacy-forward. Four fates open; her cunt clenched around the second name like unfinished testimony.

His hand at her waist. "Quiet deal with Pell—or mercy-rewrite the swear. Both leave you wet. Neither boxes my wife."

She arched, thighs tight. Mid-want first; climax belonging to the verb. His hips brushed; the almost ached louder than the map.

"If I seal with Pell," she whispered, "I wear quieter teeth and private throb." A beat. "If I soften the swear, I keep your mouth unfinished and the map wide."

Elevator chime through her teeth. Wind sheer. Wine-ringed marble. Black car. She trembled choosing, unfinished on purpose, romance locked on Nolan alone while Vivienne stayed contested.
